meta.name: hunt-business-logic
meta.description: Hunting skill for business logic vulnerabilities. Built from 12 public bug bounty reports. Covers coupon-race-stacking (Instacart, Stripe, Reverb), negative-quantity-in-cart price tampering (Upserve, Eternal/Zomato), decimal/fraction price-field overflow (Shipt), client-side checkout amount trust on PayPal redirect (WordPress.org), price-per-unit mass-assignment (Krisp), and archived-price swap / cart-TOCTOU (Stripe). Use when hunting business logic — heavy emphasis on financial-impact-demonstrated cases.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你发现业务逻辑漏洞，比如价格篡改、优惠券重复使用、验证绕过等，并给出测试方法和攻击示例。
howto.when: 当你进行安全测试或漏洞挖掘，特别是涉及支付、订单、验证流程时，Claude 会主动提供攻击思路和检测技巧。

say.text: 帮我测试这个支付接口的价格篡改漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会给出修改金额、绕过验证的步骤。

say.text: 检查这个网站的优惠券能否重复使用。
say.note: Claude 会指导如何并发请求测试。

say.text: 如何绕过这个邮箱验证？
say.note: Claude 会提供直接调用 API 或重放令牌的方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you find business logic vulnerabilities such as price tampering, coupon race conditions, and verification bypasses, providing testing methods and attack examples.
howto.when_en: When you are performing security testing or bug hunting, especially involving payment, order, or verification flows, Claude proactively offers attack techniques and detection tips.

say_en.text: Help me test this payment endpoint for price tampering.
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps to modify amounts and bypass validation.

say_en.text: Check if this site's coupons can be reused.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you on concurrent request testing.

say_en.text: How to bypass this email verification?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest direct API calls or token replay.
